text:
elaine: Quick design review — pushing an accessibility-first variant for the Spend canvas. Instead of token bubbles we show a left legend + stacked sparkline. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/example. Thoughts?
sam: I like the a11y rationale. Legend is easier for screen readers than scattered bubbles. But it adds vertical noise.
anya: Agree on screen readers. Concern: legend pushes project list below the fold on mobile.
mike: Could we collapse legend into a flyout triggered by a 'Legend' button? Keyboard-focusable, aria-expanded.
elaine: That's an option. The 'Legend' flyout would keep default compactness. But we lose at-a-glance token proportions.
luis: What about an inline compact legend row above charts — 1 line, small color swatches + counts. Tap to expand to full legend.
sam: Inline row seems fine. For contrast, we should use a11y color palette — contrast ratios >4.5:1 for token labels.
anya: Also need aria-describedby for each chart with a plain-text breakdown for screen readers (ex: "Org: 42% compute, 58% embed tokens").
mike: Implementation note: we can auto-generate descriptions from existing token aggregation keys. Devs: is this straightforward?
elaine: dev ping @mike @luis — prototyping ask: show mobile and desktop mocks with inline row, collapsed legend flyout, and pure legend variants.
luis: I'll mock three screens by EOD. Quick CSS prototype idea:
```
.legend-row { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; font-size:12px }
.legend-swatch { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:2px }
```
sam: Nice. Also copy nits: change CTA 'Download invoice' -> 'Download PDF invoice' for clarity, and add aria-label 'Download invoice PDF for {period}'.
anya: For org vs project scope switch: make scope pill persist in URL and announce via toast when changed for screen readers.
mike: Good call. Toast should use role="status" and be non-modal.
elaine: UX question: when org scope selected, should token breakdown aggregate or show compare-by-project micro-sparkline? Product prefers aggregate for clarity.
luis: Aggregate first, with a small toggle 'Compare by project' for power users.
sam: One last accessibility nit — keyboard nav: ensure legend button is reachable before charts and is tabbable orderwise.
elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate into a short spec and update the Figma link. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled 2024-03-10 16:00 UTC. Agenda has been updated.
